spans.says: And stay for the first thing the scores told me because it wasn't about the prompt at all.
and before I touched any prompt, I ran the same prompt on four live streams. A score means nothing until you know how much it moves all by itself. That's a run-to-run variance.
On two of them, both runs scored the same. On the other two, the first run scored 100% and the second scored 83.3. Same prompt, same transcript, same model.
